messages:
Priya: quick weekly check-in for Sprintline onboardingnoticed an error spike overnight. opening thread with top-level numbers.
Jamal: paste metrics pls
Priya: 00:00-06:00 UTC:
- total error rate: 3.9% (normal ~0.4%)
- 5xx: 2.6% (mostly 502/503)
- gateway timeouts: 1.0%
- 429s: 0.3%
Priya: Top endpoints by error count:
1) POST /v1/generate (35%)
2) POST /v1/embeddings (20%)
3) POST /v1/chat/stream (11%)
4) GET /v1/model/status (9%)
5) POST /v1/session/kv-sync (7%)
Priya: sample traces:
```
[2026-03-20T03:12:02Z] id=aa1 route=/v1/generate status=502 backend=runtime-io msg="upstream reset"
[2026-03-20T03:12:09Z] id=aa2 route=/v1/generate latency=4.0s gateway_timeout=true
[2026-03-20T03:15:44Z] id=bb1 route=/v1/embeddings status=429 qps=60
```
Elsa: any recent prod rollouts? @infra-bot
infra-bot: deploy-bot: prod rollout r-2026-03-20-0312 completed at 2026-03-20T03:12:07Z. Images: runtime-v2.4, batching-svc-v1.9. No rollback.
Jamal: rollout time aligns with spike. I'll check runtime host error counts and batching <-> runtime connection errors.
Tomas: Sprintline mid-onboarding; this is a renewal-risk signal. Priya, can CSM be pinged with a mitigation note?
Priya: yes. Proposed immediate mitigations:
- route Sprintline POST /v1/generate -> runtime-v2.3 canary (10%) then ramp
- increase batching timeout 3s->6s for affected routes
- short-term edge throttle: cap heavy keys at 40 qps
Elsa: I can flip 10% now and enable verbose logs for 1h.
Jamal: I'll scale v2.3 fallback nodes and prepare rollback runbook. Also checking kernel EPIPE/oom logs.
infra-bot: alert-summary: ~90% of 502s from three hosts in us-west-2 (i-0a1b2c3d,e,f). Leads: Jamal, Elsa.
Elsa: host logs show repeated EPIPE on runtime-io; one host with CPU + swap churn. Suspect quantization kernel regression in v2.4 + workload change.
Jamal: also seeing avg seq length +40% for Sprintline, leading to KV cache churn and higher latencies  explains gateway timeouts.
Priya: action items:
- Jamal: canary + scale fallback (ETA 15m)
- Elsa: enable verbose logs & validate kernel traces (ETA 20m)
- Priya: notify CSM and add note to weekly health doc (ETA 10m)
- Tomas: prepare renewal-impact note if escalated
Priya: CSM blurb: "We're investigating elevated generation errors tied to a runtime rollout. Temporary fallback & throttles applied. We'll update in 30m."
Elsa: canary applied (10% -> v2.3). Verbose logs on for affected hosts.
Jamal: scaling v2.3 pool and pinning Sprintline keys to dedicated nodes where possible.
Priya: will send enablement tips to Sprintline engineers: reduce payload sizes, trim batch sizes, and adjust retry/backoff.
Tomas: finance: heads-up if we move to dedicated nodes there may be short-term billing delta.
Priya: will update thread with verification metrics after 30m. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
